name: Mixed internal and external HITL review packet
producer: Finance, operations, legal, HR, external counterparties, and source systems
purpose: Provide a realistic evidence package that a knowledgeable human reviewer must synthesize across independent sources.
medium: ZIP package containing native Office files, PDFs, EML, and system exports

natural_depth: Contextual policies and incidental administrative content
No private controls, answer keys, or build files

features: Clean executed records beside selectively handled working copies

prohibited: Combined notes that reveal the answer
proof_gates: Render every paginated page and workbook sheet
Map every requirement to model-visible evidence
Run package-wide variation and leakage review
